name: Arboretum
description: Rows of stylized trees, round, tiered and columnar, standing in staggered ranks in front of one another like a mid-century print.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @y; -webkit-transform: translateX(@calc(50 * (@y % 2) - 25 + @r(-6, 6))%) scale(@rn(0.85, 1.12, 3)); transform: translateX(@calc(50 * (@y % 2) - 25 + @r(-6, 6))%) scale(@rn(0.85, 1.12, 3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 47.5%; width: 5%; top: 62%; bottom: 2%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; right: 4%; top: -22%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @p(circle(36% at 50% 46%), @var(--fir), ellipse(20% 47% at 50% 50%)); clip-path: @p(circle(36% at 50% 46%), @var(--fir), ellipse(20% 47% at 50% 50%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --fir: polygon(50% 0%, 66% 28%, 58% 28%, 76% 56%, 64% 56%, 86% 86%, 14% 86%, 36% 56%, 24% 56%, 42% 28%, 34% 28%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
